svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Mesh segmentation in Project Aether. Role tags are boxes, grouped by site: home lab, Oracle Cloud and Google Cloud, plus the operator and signed-in devices. The operator reaches every tag. Signed-in devices reach the apps and admin tools over HTTPS and the edge VM over SSH and monitoring. The cloud host scrapes metrics from the K3s nodes, the hypervisor and the edge VM and runs monitoring checks on the edge VM. The K3s nodes and the hypervisor send logs to the cloud host. The edge VM may check the monitored services and the public feed on the cloud host and the web ports of the cluster. The hypervisor sends heartbeats to the edge VM. Everything else is denied, and policy tests run on every save.
svg.text: Every tag is a role. An arrow points from the side that may open the connection, and anything without an arrow is denied.
HTTPS to the apps and admin tools;
SSH and monitoring on the edge VM.
The policy file carries tests. The admin console
runs them on every save and rejects a failing policy.
the cloud host's own node: scrapes, alerts and heartbeats leave from here
Policy tests check each of these.
Boxes are role tags. Each tag has one
meaning, and location never grants access.
Labels name the port role: metrics, logs,
web, monitoring. No port numbers here.
Arrows cross the mesh. Nothing else does.
